card.name: Tuberculosis drug lists and dosing
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and small words in tuberculosis drug text, mostly right after rifampin or isoniazid or inside dose lines such as 'mg/kg PO'. It also fires at scattered points inside other drug and disease names.

modes.label: Antituberculous dose tables
modes.description: Spaces, 'to' ranges and route words like PO inside dose lines for TB drugs.
modes.example: Isoniazid 10 to 20 mg/kg PO or IM 5 mg/kg PO or IM Rifampin 10 to<< >>20 mg/kg PO 10

modes.label: Commas after TB drug names
modes.description: A comma following rifampin or isoniazid in a list of drugs.

modes.label: Inside isoniazid and other names
modes.description: Partway through the name isoniazid or other long drug names.
modes.example: Serum concentrations of<< is>>oniazid may be decreased.

card.writes: It may push the model toward word starts like 'fa' and 'cong', with no clear link to the context.
card.plain: It lights up in tuberculosis drug lists and dose tables, especially around rifampin and isoniazid.
